# tebib_load_balancer_target_group (Resource)

A target group of a load balancer: the VMs (`tebib_load_balancer_target`) that listeners forward to, how traffic is spread over them and how their health is checked.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_load_balancer_target_group" "api" {
  load_balancer_id = tebib_load_balancer.web.id
  name             = "api"
  protocol         = "tcp"
  port             = 8080
  algorithm        = "least_connections"
  proxy_protocol   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer_id` (String) Load balancer ID (`lb-...`). Changing it replaces the target group.
- `name` (String) Name, unique in the load balancer. Changing it replaces the target group.
- `port` (Number) Port on the targets (1-65535), unless a target sets its own. Changes in place.

### Optional

- `algorithm` (String) `round_robin` (default), `least_connections` or `source_ip`.
- `health_check` (Attributes) How target health is checked. Default: a TCP connect to the traffic port every 10 seconds. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check))
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp` (default) or `http`. Changing it replaces the target group.
- `proxy_protocol` (Boolean) TCP only: send a PROXY protocol v2 header to the targets. Default: `false`.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Target group ID (`lbtg-...`).

<a id="nestedatt--health_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check`

Optional:

- `healthy_threshold` (Number) Checks in a row that make a target healthy (2-10). Default: 3.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between checks (5-300). Default: 10.
- `matcher` (String) HTTP checks: expected status codes, e.g. `200` or `200-399` (default).
- `path` (String) HTTP checks: the path to GET. Default: `/`.
- `port` (Number) Port to check. Default: the traffic port.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp` (default: a connect) or `http` (a GET of `path`).
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Seconds a check may take (2-120). Default: 5.
- `unhealthy_threshold` (Number) Checks in a row that make a target unhealthy (2-10). Default: 3.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <load_balancer_id>/<target_group_id>, optionally with <project_id>/ in front.
terraform import tebib_load_balancer_target_group.api lb-abc123/lbtg-def456
```
